projects.title: Running Coach AI
projects.description: A personal AI running coach that plans daily runs, logs workouts from chat, and answers progress questions from training history.
projects.problem: Strava logged the runs, but remembering the plan, deciding what to run next, and making sense of progress still took manual effort.
projects.approach: Use n8n to orchestrate chat workflows, Airtable to store running data, Supabase Vector Store to retrieve personal running history, and an LLM to generate context-aware coaching responses.
projects.aiFlag: AI agent with retrieved running context

projects.title: Axion
projects.description: A Python-first RAG exploration project built to understand retrieval systems from the inside out.
projects.problem: Tutorial RAG builds did not feel close enough to production RAG, so the project started as a deeper exploration of every moving part.
projects.approach: Build the retrieval workflow directly with Python, MySQL, Qdrant, and bge-m3 sentence-transformer embeddings while avoiding heavy orchestration frameworks.

projects.title: Roast a person based on Playlist
projects.description: A Spotify OAuth application that reads playlist data and generates a playful roast from songs and artists.
projects.problem: Turn personal playlist data into a funny generated experience while learning how real OAuth flows behave.
projects.approach: Use FastAPI, SQLite, Spotify Developer API access, cookies, refresh tokens, and Groq API generation.

projects.title: Wikipedia Speedrunner
projects.description: A prototype that tries to move from one Wikipedia page to another using links, scraping, and embedding similarity.
projects.problem: Recreate the Wikipedia speedrun challenge as a machine-driven navigation experiment.
projects.approach: Scrape page links with BeautifulSoup and requests, compare semantic similarity with sentence-transformers, and prototype the flow in Tkinter.

projects.title: NextLee
projects.description: A LeetCode problem selector that recommends the next problem from difficulty and topic commands.
projects.problem: Job hunting and LeetCode practice made choosing the next useful problem harder than expected.
projects.approach: Query LeetCode's exposed GraphQL endpoints with Python requests and cache results locally for fast problem selection.

projects.title: MART
projects.description: A Multi-Agent Research Team that plans, retrieves, stores, and refines research into structured reports.
projects.problem: Research across web, papers, PDFs, DOCX files, and technical sources needs a coordinated workflow instead of one-off searching.
projects.approach: Combine Streamlit, Groq, FAISS, sentence-transformers, LangChain, async scraping, document parsing, and reviewer/summarizer agent loops.
projects.aiFlag: AI assisted with human planning and thinking

projects.title: NutriKnow
projects.description: A food label analysis app that scans ingredients and gives feedback based on dietary needs and restrictions.
projects.problem: Useful ingredient analysis apps were hard to access locally or were behind paywalls.
projects.approach: Use FastAPI, Gemini API, EasyOCR, and Pydantic to read ingredient labels, explain ingredients, and tailor feedback.
projects.deployment: Deployed earlier and later taken down

projects.title: News Article Summarizer
projects.description: A lightweight article summarizer that fetches news from a link and estimates article polarity.
projects.problem: Quickly understand long news articles and whether their tone is positive or negative.
projects.approach: Fetch article content with Newspaper, summarize it, and estimate polarity with TextBlob in a Tkinter interface.

quotes.text: Twenty years from now you will be more disappointed by the things that you didn't do than by the ones you did do. So throw off the bowlines. Sail away from the safe harbor. Catch the trade winds in your sails. Explore. Dream. Discover.

quotes.text: Do not be too timid and squeamish about your actions. All life is an experiment. The more experiments you make the better. What if you do fail, and get fairly rolled in the dirt once or twice? Up again - you shall never be so afraid of a tumble.

quotes.text: The purpose of life is to live it, to taste experience to the utmost, to reach out eagerly and without fear for newer and richer experience.

quotes.text: To live is the rarest thing in the world. Most people just exist.
